ask.approve: approve this plan. It runs as soon as you approve.
ask.confirm: say whether this diagnosis is right.
plan.note: Code, not the model, labels each command as changing or read-only. If it goes wrong: {rollback}
impact.note: {deps} depend on it directly. The relations come from rules, not from a model's guess.
checks.after: checked by code after the run

ran.bind: Ran {plan} (hash {hash}), the same content that was approved.
accept.overall: I looked at the result: it is in the state we wanted
accept.note: Accept unlocks when every box is ticked. The boxes you tick go into the audit record.

verdict.partial: Partly right: I'll add a note
verdict.note: Your call becomes evidence the next time it meets this kind of problem.
readonly: Read-only account: you can look, not decide.
reject.placeholder: Say what to change in a sentence; the agent redoes the plan accordingly
reject.label: Reason
toast.approved: {ref} approved — the run starts in 5 seconds
toast.rejected: Changes requested on {ref} — the agent redoes the plan with your words
toast.snoozed: {ref} moved to the end; you'll be reminded in an hour
toast.done: {ref} is done: {n} checks verified by code, all passed
feed.title: Agents at work
feed.checked: {n} checks verified by code, all passed
agent.replanning: Redoing the plan with your reason
clear.big: Nothing needs your decision right now

state.failed.p: This does not mean nothing waits on you.
peek.label: Evidence
peek.graph_rule: Relation graph (built by rules, not guessed by a model)
peek.checked: Checked item by item by code
live.steerPh: Say something: e.g. “check the downstream timeout first”

world.scrub: Drag to go back in time
legend.none: No open issue (not the same as healthy)
node.none: No open issue. That is not the same as healthy: nothing abnormal was found.
cmd.placeholder: Say something, or type / for commands, @ for objects
cmd.label: Command
cmd.criticalOn: Showing critical only. Type “Everything” to undo
cmd.notDrawn: Not drawn yet (stage {stage}); it will open from here
help.title: Hands on the keyboard
help.p: One decision per page. These keys work whenever you are not typing; single-key shortcuts can be switched off in the account menu.
help.primary: this page's main action (hold it when it changes infrastructure)
help.reject: request changes / not accepted (with a reason)
help.prov: Every sentence says which one it is.
brief.label: The brief for this item
returned.replanned: ↩ Redone as asked — back with you
returned.newPlan: ↩ The agent wrote a plan — back with you
returned.reviewed: ↩ The agent finished its review — back with you
returned.needsAcceptance: ↩ The run finished — a check needs your eyes
plan.window: It does not run at once: it starts after {t}.
ask.approveWindow: approve this plan. It starts after {t}.
ask.failed: pick the next step: a new plan, or a new diagnosis.
ask.not_started: retry the run, or withdraw the approval. A retry runs at once.
ask.replan: have the agent redo the plan as the reviewer asked.
ask.rerun: run the diagnosis again with your hint.
ask.generate: have the agent write a fix plan from this diagnosis.
ask.resolve.unverified: this run left no verdict: confirm it is resolved, or have the agent run the checks now.
ask.start_review: send this change to the agent for review. A review only reads.
ask.acceptChange: look at {n} checks, then confirm the change is complete.
approved.line: {by} approved this version at {t} UTC (hash {hash}). The content has not changed since.
sec.whoRejected: Who sent it back, and why
sec.rejectedPlan: The plan that was sent back (v{v})
resolve.autoOff: Every check passed. Auto-resolve is off, so it waits for you.
resolve.noVerdict: This run predates per-check verification and left no verdict: the verdict field is empty.
review.note: The review checks that the targets exist, that each command is safe, and what it touches.
clarify.label: Answer to question {n}
toast.sentPlan: {ref}: handed to the agent for a plan
toast.sentRca: {ref}: handed to the agent for a new diagnosis
toast.sentReview: {ref}: handed to the agent for review
toast.sentCheck: {ref}: handed to the agent to run the checks
toast.answered: {ref}: answers sent, the agent goes on with its review
story.label: The history of this item
story.rca.summary: The model's own confidence {self}; review: {critic}; location: {location}.
story.rca.needsYou: Below the gate: it waits for your call.
story.review.stuck: The review is stuck: {n} questions wait for you.
story.request.draft: A draft, not yet sent for review.
story.plan.summary: {label} v{v}  {hash}  {n} steps, {w} of them change things.
story.approve.pending: You just approved; still inside the undo window.
story.run.notStarted: Approved, but the run did not start.
story.run.fixed: The run finished; every check was verified by code and passed.
story.accept.resolve: Every check passed; it waits for you to mark it resolved.
story.accept.noVerdict: No verdict; it waits for your confirmation.
note.label: Note
note.rule: Notes are append-only: no edit, no delete.
close.label: Reason
close.placeholder: Why this needs no action (required; it goes to the audit log)
rejectChange.placeholder: Why it is rejected (required; it goes to the audit log)
reject.note: The plan is redone with this sentence; the new version comes back to you with the changed steps marked.
close.note: It leaves the queue; new signals from the same source merge into it without a reminder. It can be reopened later.
rejectChange.note: A rejected change ends here; doing it later takes a new request.
story.closed: You dismissed this. New signals from the same source merge in without a reminder; it can be reopened.
story.rejectedChange: You rejected this change; it ends here.
help.close: dismiss the item / reject the change (with a reason)
toast.reopened: {ref} reopened — an agent looks at it again
story.plan.steps: Show every step of this version
story.none.p: It does not exist, or you may not see it.
live.ack: Understood. Checking that first, then carrying on.
returned.stopped: ↩ You stopped the run; it was rolled back
toast.stopped: {ref}: run stopped and rolled back — it is back in your queue
toast.stoppedChange: {ref} stopped and rolled back — the change ends here
toast.stopTooLate: {ref}: too late — the last step was already running, so it finished
toast.stopAsked: {ref}: it stops after this step, then rolls back
ask.stopped: You stopped this run and it was rolled back. Decide what is next: a new plan, or a new diagnosis.
ran.stopped: Run #{run} was stopped by you after step {n}, {duration} in.
live.title: Agents at work
live.stale: Connection lost; reconnecting. This is what it looked like at {t} UTC — nothing can be steered, paused or stopped for now.
live.noSteer: A run follows the version you approved: its steps cannot be changed midway, only stopped. After a stop the current step finishes, then the plan's rollback runs.
live.stoppingNote: Stop requested. The step in progress cannot be cut halfway; the rollback starts when it finishes.
live.rollbackNote: Rolling back as planned. When that is done the item returns to your queue.
live.empty.big: No agent is running right now
help.live: live: say a word / pause or resume (a run: hold to stop)
help.world: map: find / replay / step by event / back to now

world.noneAbnormal: Nothing in this view is flagged. That is not the same as healthy: nothing abnormal was found.
world.past: You are looking at {t} UTC ({d} ago): what was not normal is as of that moment; the links are today's relation graph.
node.linksLlm: {n} of the links are inferred by a model (dashed) — advisory only.

world.failed.p: This does not mean the resources are gone, or that all is well. Last success: {t} UTC.

world.empty.p: Connect a cloud account and run one scan; the map fills in after that.
